F-9cff4749da27.text: `Finish`, or `Next ›` on the last exercise, with a clock running loses the hold without a word: `WorkoutFinishSheet` takes only `content`. F-c7af69eff8ac.text: A mis-tapped `Start` can't be cancelled. `Log set` is disabled until `Stop`, and a `Stop` after a second replaces the entry's time with those few seconds, so a time typed or stopped earlier has to be entered again. State it in the known limitations; a cancel is a design question, not this round's.

F-ccaf122f057f.text: **Tapping `Stop` twice can lose the hold's time.** `Start again` appears where `Stop` was, as the boards draw it, so a second tap starts a new clock. `Stopped at 1:07` goes, the Time box still reads 1:07, and `Log set` is disabled. A `Stop` more than a second later then replaces 1:07 with those few seconds, and nothing on screen still shows the old time. The third known limitation covers this mechanism through a mis-tapped `Start`, but a tired user at the end of a hold makes the double tap the likelier way in. Either ignore `Start again` for about half a second after `Stop`, which `nowMillis` lets a test hold, or name the double tap in that limitation.
